title: 第八章 忍者之惩罚第九章 轮回之眼
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
"波风冥帝、迈特凯、还有犬冢花，你们竟然又在课堂上睡觉，全部到外面去给我罚站！"冥帝从夕日红家离开，便是i去了学校睡觉。
此时伊比喜老师再次展示出了他的独门绝招--狮子吼，"还有你神月出云，又在课堂上看着你的刀发呆，也出去站着！"
揉着被这声狮子吼震得嗡嗡响耳朵，冥帝几人只得无奈地出去了，不过那姿势怎么看怎么像古惑仔，关键是冥帝身后的几人看着那个姿势不知道是不是也脑抽了，竟也学者那样的姿势大摇大摆、吊儿郎当地做出了教室。
事实证明，千万不要在老师的面前太拽，这不，这几个小子就尝到了自己酿的苦果：正在气头上的伊比喜看着他们这样的一幅姿态，顿时气不打一处来，再次怒吼道："你们几个，马上下去绕着操场跑二十圈，不，跑五十圈再回来罚站！"
"天哪！"教室里顿时出现一股抽冷气的声音，同时其他人在心里默默告诉自己：以后千万不要惹伊比喜老师生气。
"完了！"这是几个班级不良分子的心声。
"还真是麻烦呢！"冥帝不由想到。
但是借他们一个胆子也不敢跟老师对着干啊，冥帝也不想伊比喜和水门说自己在班级里的事情，于是乎，顶着炎炎的烈日，几个矮矮的身影开始围绕着操场跑动起来。
此时个人的身体素质也就体现出来了：跑到第十八圈的时候，神月出云的体力就支持不下去了，看样子神月出云的身体素质不怎么样啊，仗着自己的智慧吗？但本身没有实力再高的智慧又能怎么样呢？
等到第二十三圈跑完，迈特凯，犬冢花也跑不下去了，一坐在了地上，一个个缺少锻炼的家伙，木叶，真的腐朽了呢！冥帝叹气。
现在还在操场上跑动着的就只有冥帝和犬冢花的那一只野狗了，但此时野狗的体力也在逐渐下降，速度已经明显慢了下来，远远落后于冥帝了。
估计那一只狗到现在还能坚持的原因就在于他的种族吧，毕竟是狗啊！而且是训练有素的狗！
三十圈后，犬冢花的那一只狗终于还是坚持不住倒了下来，场上只剩下冥帝还在跑动着了，此时场外的迈特凯等人目瞪口呆地看着冥帝一直在保持着匀速跑动，而且速度还比他们快，已经彻底被震撼到了。
"那真的是冥帝吗？他比我小啊！"迈特凯有些不敢相信的问道，问的时候还不停地擦着眼睛。他一直将卡卡西看作是自己的目标！
可没想到现在又出现了一个变态小子？
"我们都没有看错，那确实是冥帝，！"神月出云气喘吁吁道。
"你们确定那个还在操场上跑动的变态是我们的同班同学，那个整天上课睡懒觉的波风冥帝？？？"犬冢花还是不敢相信。也是啊，犬冢花一家人在学校的时候都是比较自大的，看着跟自己同一个班的，而且上课不认真听讲的冥帝竟然一下子像变了一个人一样，超过自己这么多，确实让他无法接受。
"你们发现了吗？"神月出云问道。
"发现什么？"迈特凯不由得问道。
"你们仔细看冥帝的脸。"

"这，这，这怎么可能？？？那家伙还是人吗？"迈特凯他们看了冥帝的脸色后都无法抑制住惊讶地说道。
"冥帝，一直被木叶传诵为何宇智波鼬一样得到天才，我以前不觉得，现在我知道他一定是我们这一届的no.1！"神月出云分析道。"在这样的大热天，在这么毒辣的太阳下跑了这么久，脸上竟然没有一滴汗，而且速度一点也没有减慢，冥帝的实力，很恐怖呢！"此时神月出云已经被汗透的身上不由得有渗出了一身冷汗。
迈特凯两人都不由得打了一个寒战，即使**辣的太阳就在头顶上挂着！谁能想到一个四岁小孩会这么强！
放学的铃声适时响起，默然无声的几个人慢慢地转头离开，连落在教室里书也没有收拾。此时迈特凯忽然转过头来对着冥帝说道："冥帝，我是不会输给你的，你看着吧，总有一天我要超越你！青春，就是要战斗！"
"是吗？那就放马过来吧，我随时等着你！"说完，冥帝就转身走向教室去收拾自己的东西了。
"冥帝"收拾完东西准备离开的冥帝忽然听到伊比喜在叫他。
"有什么事吗？伊比喜老师"
"我对于你这个学生，很有兴趣。今天有空吗？老师请客！"伊比喜看着冥帝微笑地说道。
"真的吗？好耶！我要吃一乐拉面！"冥帝不由道。原著之中，鸣人爱死一乐拉面了，冥帝也想看看是不是真的那么好吃。
"那么，还等什么？快点一起走吧！"
"好！"冥帝点了点头。
冥帝和伊比喜便是一起去吃了一乐拉面。说实话，冥帝觉得不怎么好吃！鸣人之所以那么爱吃，冥帝觉得一定是从小没有吃过好东西的关系。
"你回来啦！"当冥帝吃完拉回家，进入大门的时候，马上便是听到夕日红高兴的声音！
"夕日红姐姐，你怎么在这里？"冥帝好奇的问道、
"水门大人，和玖辛奈老师出去了，好像有什么会议。所以，我就来照顾你了。"夕日红从厨房之中走了出来
"怎么了吗？这样看着姐姐？"见到冥帝呆呆的看着自己，夕日红不由温声对冥帝问道！

content_en:
"Namikaze Hades, Metkai, and Inuzuka Hana, you actually slept in class again. You all went outside to make me stand!" Hades left Yuhiko's house and went to school to sleep.
At this time, Teacher Ibiki once again showed off his unique skill - the lion's roar, "And you, Kamizuki Izumo, were in class looking at your sword in a daze, so you went out and stood there too!"
Rubbing their ears that were buzzing from the roar of the lion, Hades Emperor and the others had no choice but to go out. However, the posture looked like Young and Dangerous. The key was that the people behind Hades Emperor looked at that posture and wondered if they were also having a trance. They actually walked into the classroom in a swaggering and nonchalant manner like a scholar.
Facts have proved that you should never be too pushy in front of the teacher. No, these boys tasted the bitter consequences of their own brewing: Yibixi, who was in anger, looked at their postures and suddenly became angry. He roared again: "You guys, go down and run twenty laps around the playground right away. No, run fifty laps and then come back and stand for punishment!"
"Oh my God!" A sound of air-conditioning suddenly appeared in the classroom, and at the same time, others silently told themselves: Never make Teacher Ibixi angry in the future.
"It's over!" This is the voice of several bad elements in the class.
"It's really troublesome!" Emperor Hades couldn't help but think.
But they didn't dare to confront the teacher even if they didn't have the courage, and Hades didn't want Ibiki and Minato to talk about his affairs in the class, so under the scorching sun, several short figures began to run around the playground.
At this time, personal physical fitness is also reflected: when running on the 18th lap, Kamizuki Izumo's physical strength can no longer support it. It seems that Kamizuki Izumo's physical fitness is not very good. Are you relying on your own wisdom? But what can you do if you don’t have the strength and wisdom?
By the time the twenty-third lap was completed, Metkai and Inuzuka Hana couldn't run anymore. They sat on the ground. They were all lacking exercise. Konoha was really rotten! Emperor Hades sighed.
The only wild dogs still running on the playground are Hades and Hana Inuzuka, but at this time the wild dogs' physical strength is gradually declining, and their speed has slowed down significantly, lagging far behind Hades.
I guess the reason why that dog is still persisting is because of his race. After all, he is a dog! And it’s a well-trained dog!
After thirty laps, Inuzuka Hana's dog finally couldn't hold on and fell down. Only Hades was still running on the field. At this time, Metkai and others outside the field were stunned to see Hades running at a constant speed, and the speed was faster than them. They were completely shocked.
"Is that really the Emperor of Hades? He is younger than me!" Metkai asked in disbelief, wiping his eyes constantly while asking. He has always regarded Kakashi as his goal!
But you didn't expect that another perverted kid would appear now?
"We are all right, that is indeed Emperor Hades!" Shenyue Izumo panted.
"Are you sure that pervert still running on the playground is our classmate, the Namikaze Hade who slept in in class all day long???" Hana Inuzuka still couldn't believe it. Yes, Inuzuka Hana and his family were quite arrogant when they were in school. It was really unacceptable for him to see Hades, who was in the same class as him and didn't pay attention in class, suddenly seem to be a different person, surpassing him by so much.
"Have you discovered it?" Shenyue Izumo asked.
"What did you find?" MaiTekai couldn't help but ask.
"Look carefully at the face of Emperor Hades."
"This, this, how is this possible??? Is that guy still a human?" Metkai and the others couldn't restrain their surprise after looking at Hades's face.
"Underworld Emperor, it has been passed down in Konoha why Uchiha Itachi got geniuses like him. I didn't think before, but now I know he must be the No. 1 in our class!" Izumo Kamizuki analyzed. "On such a hot day, after running under such a scorching sun for so long, there was not a drop of sweat on my face, and my speed did not slow down at all. The strength of Emperor Hades is terrifying!" At this time, Shenyue Izumo couldn't help but break out in cold sweat.
Both Metkay couldn't help but shudder, even though the scorching sun was hanging directly above their heads! Who would have thought that a four-year-old child could be so strong!
The school bell rang at the right time, and a few silent people slowly turned their heads and left, not even picking up the books they left in the classroom. At this time, Metkai suddenly turned his head and said to Emperor Hades: "Emperor Hades, I will not lose to you. Just watch. One day I will surpass you! Youth means fighting!"
"Really? Then come over here, I'll be waiting for you at any time!" After saying that, Hades turned and walked to the classroom to pack his things.
"Emperor Hades" After packing up his things and preparing to leave, Emperor Hades suddenly heard Yi Bixi calling him.
"What's the matter? Teacher Ibiki"
"I am very interested in you as a student. Are you free today? Teacher, I'm treating you!" Ibixi looked at Hades and said with a smile.
"Really? Yes! I want to eat Ichiraku Ramen!" Emperor Hades couldn't help but say. In the original work, Naruto loves Ichiraku Ramen, and Hades wants to see if it is really that delicious.
"Then, what are you waiting for? Let's go together quickly!"
"Okay!" Emperor Hades nodded.
Hades and Ibiki went to eat Ichiraku Ramen together. To be honest, Hades Emperor doesn’t think it tastes very good! The reason why Naruto loves to eat so much, Hades thinks it must be because he has never eaten good food since he was a child.
"You're back!" When Hades came home after eating and entered the gate, he immediately heard Yuhi Hong's happy voice!
"Sister Xihihong, why are you here?" Emperor Ming asked curiously,
"Lord Minato, you went out with Kushina-sensei. There seems to be some meeting. So, I'm here to take care of you." Yuhi Kurenai walked out of the kitchen
"What's wrong? Looking at my sister like this?" Seeing Emperor Hades looking at her blankly, Yuhi Hong couldn't help but ask Emperor Hades in a warm voice!
